data.title: Korro Bio Retains Buy Rating as Advancing RNA Editing Pipeline and Strong Cash Runway Support Unchanged $15 Price Target
data.description:
Korro Bio, the Healthcare sector company, was revisited by a Wall Street analyst today. Analyst Mitchell Kapoor from H.C. Wainwright reiterated a Buy rating on the stock and has a $15.00 price target.

Claim 55% Off TipRanks

  • Unlock powerful investing tools with TipRanks Premium to make smarter, more confident investment decisions
  • Subscribe to TipRanks Smart Investor Newsletter, and discover new investing opportunities with data-backed stock picks

Mitchell Kapoor has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Korro Bio’s advancing pipeline and solid financial position. He highlights the formal selection of KRRO-111 for alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency, supported by robust preclinical data showing strong editing of SERPINA1 and meaningful restoration of functional AAT, along with reductions in pathogenic protein and aggregates, which together point to a differentiated subcutaneous therapy for both lung and liver disease.

Kapoor also emphasizes that KRRO-121 remains on schedule to enter first-in-human studies in the second half of 2026, with EMA orphan drug status in urea cycle disorders and a third GalNAc-conjugated candidate expected to be named in the same timeframe, creating multiple potential value catalysts. He notes that Korro’s cash runway extends into the second half of 2028, funding clinical readouts for both lead assets, and that his discounted cash flow analysis, using conservative approval probabilities and excluding upside from pipeline expansion, supports an unchanged 12‑month price target of $15 per share.

According to TipRanks, Kapoor is a 4-star analyst with an average return of 11.0% and a 42.25% success rate. Kapoor covers the Healthcare sector, focusing on stocks such as Incyte, Ionis Pharmaceuticals, and BioMarin Pharmaceutical.

In another report released today, Clear Street also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $18.00 price target.
